_about: Copy to roofora.config.local.json (git-ignored) and fill in. Contains IDs only — never secrets. The committed workflow exports in automation/workflows are always built from THIS example file, so they carry placeholders.
_gmailQuery_about: Gmail search used by reply detection. For tests it is narrowed to the test sender, e.g. "in:inbox from:test@example.com newer_than:1d".
_settingsSeed_about: settingsSeed = values written into the Airtable Settings row the FIRST time Setup Check creates it (never overwrites an existing row). Demo values only; keep real addresses in the git-ignored local config.
_alertPrefix_about: Text put in front of every Telegram alert. Local test config uses "ROOFORA — TEST · "; clear it for production.
